en.headline: Universal Funeral Parlour limited to partial service after power fault
en.dek: Tung Wah Group of Hospitals said a busbar and fuse failure at the Hung Hom parlour left some floors without full air-conditioning and lighting; full operations are expected to resume on Thursday afternoon.
body: The Universal Funeral Parlour in Hung Hom is operating only limited service after a power system fault that began on Sunday, the Tung Wah Group of Hospitals said.

According to the group, a busbar riser and fuse in the second-floor meter room failed. Some floors temporarily lost lighting and air-conditioning, and the exhaust system and goods lifts were affected. The mortuary and body cold storage remained unaffected, the group said. Engineers restored partial power, and remaining air-conditioning and lift works are scheduled for completion on Thursday afternoon, after which normal operations should resume.

Some families with ceremonies booked on affected floors were moved to other halls within the parlour or to nearby funeral homes. Tung Wah apologised for the inconvenience and said staff were contacting funeral directors in order of scheduled funeral dates to coordinate arrangements.

zh.headline: 寰宇殯儀館電力故障僅限有限度服務 料周四復常
zh.dek: 東華三院指紅磡寰宇殯儀館二樓電表房滙流排及保險絲故障，部分樓層冷氣及照明受影響，殮房正常，預計周四下午全面修復。
body: 紅磡寰宇殯儀館因電力系統故障，目前只能提供有限度靈堂租用服務，東華三院表示預計周四下午恢復正常營運。
院方指，周日下午館內二樓電表房滙流排及保險絲故障，部分樓層靈堂一度沒有照明及空調，抽煙系統及載貨電梯亦受影響。地庫殮房及遺體冷藏設備則不受影響。經緊急維修後已恢復部分供電，其餘空調及載貨電梯預計周四下午完成修理。
部分原安排在受影響樓層設靈的喪家，已改到館內其他靈堂或附近殯儀館。東華三院就事件向受影響人士致歉，並表示職員會按出殯日期先後聯絡殮葬商協調安排。
